Semantic Role Labeling for the sentence: "The journalist traveled to multiple countries to gather firsthand accounts and document the impact of the global policy shift."

Main Verb 1: traveled
- Agent (Who traveled?): The journalist
- Destination/Location (Where to?): to multiple countries
- Purpose/Reason (Why?): to gather firsthand accounts and document the impact of the global policy shift

Main Verb 2: gather (infinitive phrase acting as purpose)
- Agent (Who gathers?): The journalist (implied from the main clause)
- Theme/Patient (What is gathered?): firsthand accounts

Main Verb 3: document (infinitive phrase acting as purpose)
- Agent (Who documents?): The journalist (implied from the main clause)
- Theme/Patient (What is documented?): the impact of the global policy shift
- Modifier of Theme: of the global policy shift (specifies which impact)
